theorems.name: Submission.smr_ufd_cl_inner_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet E → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < μ (W ∩ E) → ∃ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ W ∩ E ∧ c < μ K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
